note: Curated geometry payloads for textbook Hodge keys. Class-level examples — not uniqueness proofs.

geometries.name: Quintic threefold in P^4
geometries.triangulation: projective-ambient-P4 (unique smooth ambient; no toric FRST required)
geometries.hypersurface_equation: sum_{|alpha|=5} c_alpha x^alpha = 0  (generic quintic; Fermat: x0^5+...+x4^5=0)

geometries.name: Mirror quintic (Greene–Plesser)
geometries.ambient: Orbifold of Fermat quintic / toric mirror
geometries.triangulation: Greene-Plesser orbifold resolution of Fermat quintic mirror family
geometries.hypersurface_equation: x0^5+x1^5+x2^5+x3^5+x4^5 - 5 psi x0 x1 x2 x3 x4 = 0 (mirror family)

geometries.name: Bicubic in P2 x P2
geometries.hypersurface_equation: bidegree (3,3) section of O(3,3) on P2 x P2

geometries.name: Tetraquadric in (P1)^4
geometries.ambient: P1 x P1 x P1 x P1

geometries.name: CICY P5[2,4]

geometries.name: CICY P5[3,3]
